documents.title: AWS Well-Architected Framework — Security Pillar
documents.license: Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
documents.description: Comprehensive architectural guidance for securing workloads on AWS, covering Identity & Access Management (SEC01-SEC03), Detection & Monitoring (SEC04-SEC05), Infrastructure Protection (SEC06), Data Protection (SEC07-SEC09), and Incident Response (SEC10-SEC11).

documents.title: Security Best Practices for Amazon S3
documents.license: Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
documents.description: Amazon S3 prescriptive security best practices covering bucket policy hardening, Block Public Access (BPA), object encryption (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS), versioning, Object Lock, Macie classification, and least-privilege IAM policies.

documents.title: Security Hub CSPM Controls for Amazon S3
documents.license: Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
documents.description: 42 formal AWS Security Hub Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) controls for Amazon S3, including S3.1 (Block Public Access), S3.5 (Require TLS), S3.8 (Default Server-Side Encryption), S3.13 (Lifecycle Configuration), and S3.14 (Cross-Region Replication).
